name: World of You
source:
[i]Have you ever wished to be somebody else?[/i]

Mei is ready to make a new start, hoping to return to in-person classes in the aftermath of a leave of absence. Together with her cousin and best friend, Chrissy, Mei prepares to navigate the turbulent waters of high school. However, her apprehension turns to uncertainty as she contends with social anxiety, chronic health issues, and a growing distance with Chrissy.

The only thing that gives her respite is an odd video game centered around a girl named Kimi, determined to achieve the "ideal" teenager experience - becoming prom queen. Will Mei find the high-school life she hopes for within the game, or does something darker lurk within? When freedom, family, and fear find themselves clashing, how far would you go to achieve your dreams?

Family drama, self-discovery, and subversive RPGmaker horror come together to create a heartfelt coming-of-age visual novel that will leave you just as scared as hopeful… depending on the choices you make, of course!

[Edited from [URL=https://mustacheskulls.itch.io/world-of-you]Itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
[i]你是否曾希望自己能成为另一个人？[/i]

休学一段时间后，梅准备好重新出发，期盼着重返线下课堂。在表亲兼挚友克莉茜的陪伴下，梅准备应对风浪重重的高中生活。然而，面对社交焦虑、慢性健康问题，以及与克莉茜之间日益扩大的隔阂，她心中的忐忑逐渐化作了迷茫。

唯一能让她喘息片刻的，是一款围绕名叫吉米的女孩展开的奇怪电子游戏——游戏里的女孩立志要实现“理想”的青春期体验：成为毕业舞会皇后。梅会在游戏中寻得她所期盼的高中生活，还是说其中潜藏着更为黑暗的东西？当自由、家庭与恐惧发生激烈碰撞时，为了实现梦想，你愿意走到哪一步？

家庭纠葛、自我探索与颠覆性的RPG Maker恐怖元素交织融合，铸就了这部真挚动人的成长题材视觉小说，让你在心生恐惧的同时又满怀希望……当然，这完全取决于你所做出的选择！

[改编自[URL=https://mustacheskulls.itch.io/world-of-you]Itch.io[/URL]]
